description: This file contains database migration scripts for upgrading vtiger CRM from version 5.3.0 to 5.4.0RC, including schema updates, workflow and event setup, module relationships, and configuration changes.

classes.name: VTEntityMethodManager
classes.description: Manages registration of entity methods for workflows and events.

classes.name: VTWorkflowManager
classes.description: Handles creation and management of workflows.

classes.name: Vtiger_Cron
classes.description: Handles registration of scheduled cron jobs.

classes.name: Vtiger_Access
classes.description: Manages module sharing and access permissions.

classes.name: Vtiger_Module
classes.description: Represents a module in vtiger CRM, with methods for instance retrieval and synchronization.

classes.name: Vtiger_Block
classes.description: Represents a block within a module, with methods to add fields.

classes.name: Vtiger_Field
classes.description: Represents a database field in a module.

methods.name: addEntityMethod
methods.description: Registers an entity method for a specific module.

methods.name: newWorkFlow
methods.description: Creates a new workflow for a module.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task for a workflow.

methods.name: deleteSharing
methods.description: Deletes sharing rules for a module.

methods.name: initSharing
methods.description: Initializes sharing rules for a module.

methods.name: setDefaultSharing
methods.description: Sets default sharing rules for a module.

methods.name: AddColumn
methods.description: Adds a column to a database table.

methods.name: getFieldid
methods.description: Retrieves the field ID for a given module and field name.

methods.description: Constructs full name from query result.

methods.name: getSettingsBlockId
methods.description: Retrieves the block ID for a settings block.
